new-unsure.title: Start with a fundamentals exam
new-unsure.summary: Fundamentals exams need no experience and show you what each area is about. Take the one that sounds the most interesting.

new-azure.title: Start with Azure Fundamentals
new-azure.summary: AZ-900 is the Microsoft Azure Fundamentals exam. Add DP-900 for data or AI-901 for AI if those interest you.

next.label: Ready for a role-based Azure exam?

new-m365.title: Start with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
new-m365.summary: AB-900 covers Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent administration basics. The hub has no other Microsoft 365 fundamentals page.

next.label: Ready for a role-based Microsoft 365 exam?

new-security.title: Start with Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
new-security.summary: SC-900 is the Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals exam.

next.label: Ready for a role-based security exam?

new-power.title: Start with Power Platform Fundamentals
new-power.summary: PL-900 is the Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals exam.

next.label: Ready for a role-based Power Platform exam?

new-dynamics.title: Start with Power Platform Fundamentals
new-dynamics.summary: The hub has no Dynamics 365 fundamentals page. PL-900 covers the Power Platform that Dynamics 365 apps build on and is a good shared starting point.

new-aibusiness.title: Start with an AI for business exam
new-aibusiness.summary: AB-730 is the AI Business Professional exam. AB-900 covers Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent administration basics.

new-github.title: Start with GitHub Foundations
new-github.summary: GH-900 is the GitHub Foundations exam.

next.label: Ready for a role-based GitHub exam?

r-azure-admin.title: Azure Administrator
r-azure-admin.summary: AZ-104 is the core exam for people who deploy and manage Azure resources. If you want to design solutions later, AZ-305 is the next step.

r-windows-server.title: Windows Server administration
r-windows-server.summary: AZ-802 covers Windows Server administration: identity, storage, networking and hybrid management.

r-azure-network.title: Azure networking
r-azure-network.summary: AZ-700 covers designing and implementing Azure networking solutions.

r-azure-avd.title: Azure Virtual Desktop
r-azure-avd.summary: AZ-140 is for administrators who configure and operate Azure Virtual Desktop.

r-azure-sap.title: SAP workloads on Azure
r-azure-sap.summary: AZ-120 is for engineers who plan and administer SAP workloads on Azure.

r-azure-devops.title: DevOps on Azure
r-azure-devops.summary: AZ-401 is the replacement for AZ-400, which is retiring.

r-azure-dev.title: Developing cloud solutions on Azure
r-azure-dev.summary: AI-200 covers AI backend development on Azure: containers, data services and secure cloud integration. It follows the retired AZ-204.

r-azure-ai-apps.title: AI applications and agents on Azure
r-azure-ai-apps.summary: AI-103 is for developers who build AI applications and agents on Azure.

r-azure-mlops.title: Machine learning and generative AI in production
r-azure-mlops.summary: AI-300 is for engineers who operationalize machine learning and generative AI solutions.

r-azure-multi-agent.title: Multi-agent AI solutions
r-azure-multi-agent.summary: AI-500 is for engineers who design and implement solutions with several cooperating agents.

r-azure-cosmos.title: AI applications on Azure Cosmos DB
r-azure-cosmos.summary: DP-420 is for developers who build AI applications with Azure Cosmos DB.

r-fabric-engineer.title: Data engineering in Microsoft Fabric
r-fabric-engineer.summary: DP-700 is for data engineers who build pipelines and lakehouses in Fabric. DP-600 is the matching analytics exam.

r-fabric-analytics.title: Analytics in Microsoft Fabric
r-fabric-analytics.summary: DP-600 is for analytics engineers who build semantic models and analytics solutions in Fabric. DP-700 is the matching data engineering exam.

r-sql-admin.title: Azure SQL administration
r-sql-admin.summary: DP-300 is for database administrators who run Azure SQL.

r-databricks.title: Data engineering on Azure Databricks
r-databricks.summary: DP-750 is for data engineers who build solutions on Azure Databricks.

r-sql-dev.title: AI-enabled database solutions
r-sql-dev.summary: DP-800 is for developers who build AI-enabled solutions on databases.

r-m365-endpoint.title: Managing endpoints with Intune
r-m365-endpoint.summary: MD-102 is for administrators who manage and secure devices with Microsoft Intune.

r-m365-teams.title: Microsoft Teams
r-m365-teams.summary: Take MS-700, the Teams administrator exam, first. MS-721 (collaboration communications systems: Teams calling, meetings, devices and rooms) is the next exam on this path.

r-m365-admin.title: Administering Microsoft 365 and AI services
r-m365-admin.summary: AB-650 covers Microsoft 365 and AI administration: Copilot, agents, security and governance. It replaces MS-102, which is retiring.

r-sec-soc.title: Security operations
r-sec-soc.summary: SC-200 is for analysts who detect, investigate and respond to threats. SC-100 is the architect-level exam to take later.

r-sec-identity.title: Identity and access
r-sec-identity.summary: SC-300 is for administrators who manage identity and access with Microsoft Entra. SC-100 is the architect-level exam to take later.

r-sec-information.title: Information protection and compliance
r-sec-information.summary: SC-401 covers information security in Microsoft 365: Microsoft Purview, data protection and loss prevention. SC-100 is the architect-level exam to take later.

r-sec-cloud.title: Security for cloud and AI workloads
r-sec-cloud.summary: SC-500 covers end-to-end security controls for cloud and AI workloads. SC-100 is the architect-level exam to take later.

r-power-consultant.title: Building intelligent applications on Power Platform
r-power-consultant.summary: AB-410 is the exam for building intelligent applications on Power Platform. It follows the retired PL-200.

r-power-developer.title: Extending Power Platform with code and AI
r-power-developer.summary: AB-400 is about extending Power Platform with code and AI. It is the renamed PL-400.

r-power-analyst.title: Data analysis with Power BI
r-power-analyst.summary: PL-300 is for analysts who model, visualize and share data with Power BI.

r-dyn-service.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
r-dyn-service.summary: MB-230 is for functional consultants who implement Dynamics 365 Customer Service.

r-dyn-finance.title: Dynamics 365 Finance
r-dyn-finance.summary: MB-310 is for functional consultants who implement Dynamics 365 Finance.

r-dyn-supply.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
r-dyn-supply.summary: AB-330 covers AI-powered supply chain operations with Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. It replaces MB-330, which is retiring.

r-dyn-other.title: Not covered on this hub yet
r-dyn-other.summary: The hub has no pages for the Business Central or Finance and Operations exams yet. Microsoft's certification poster lists every Dynamics 365 exam.

r-ai-professional.title: AI Business Professional
r-ai-professional.summary: AB-730 is the AI Business Professional exam, for using AI tools in everyday work. No coding is needed.

r-ai-leader.title: AI Transformation Leader
r-ai-leader.summary: AB-731 is the AI Transformation Leader exam, for leading AI adoption in an organization. No coding is needed.

r-ai-admin.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent administration
r-ai-admin.summary: AB-900 covers how to administer Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents.

r-ai-sales.title: AI in Dynamics 365 Sales
r-ai-sales.summary: AB-210 is about accelerating sales pipelines with AI in Dynamics 365.

r-ai-contact-center.title: AI in Dynamics 365 Contact Center
r-ai-contact-center.summary: AB-250 is about transforming contact center experiences with AI in Dynamics 365.

r-ai-copilot-studio.title: Agents in Copilot Studio
r-ai-copilot-studio.summary: AB-620 is for builders who design and build integrated AI solutions in Copilot Studio.

r-ai-intelligent-apps.title: Intelligent applications
r-ai-intelligent-apps.summary: AB-410 is for builders of intelligent applications.

r-ai-architect.title: Agentic AI architecture
r-ai-architect.summary: AB-100 is for architects who design agentic AI business solutions.

r-gh-foundations.title: GitHub Foundations
r-gh-foundations.summary: GH-900 is the GitHub Foundations exam.

r-gh-admin.title: GitHub Enterprise Administrator
r-gh-admin.summary: GH-100 is for administrators who run a GitHub enterprise.

r-gh-actions.title: GitHub Actions
r-gh-actions.summary: GH-200 is for engineers who automate builds and deployments with GitHub Actions.

r-gh-security.title: GitHub Advanced Security
r-gh-security.summary: GH-500 is for engineers who secure code with GitHub Advanced Security.

r-gh-copilot.title: GitHub Copilot
r-gh-copilot.summary: GH-300 is for developers who work with GitHub Copilot.

r-gh-agentic.title: Developing agentic AI systems
r-gh-agentic.summary: GH-600 is for developers who build agentic AI systems with GitHub.

r-gh-business.title: Agentic AI for operational efficiency
r-gh-business.summary: GH-700 is the non-technical exam for product managers, program managers and business analysts who want to improve operations with agentic AI.
